title: ke or c at the End
rule: After a long vowel, the k sound is spelled k e, like make. In a word with two or more syllables, it is spelled with just c, like picnic.
trickText: Count the syllables first. Two or more syllables? Use c. One syllable? Look at the ONE letter before the k sound: short vowel alone, c k. Long vowel with a sneaky e, k e. Consonant or vowel team, k.
say: Today's case: more ways to spell the k sound at the end. After a long vowel, we use k e, like make. In a longer word, with two or more syllables, we use just c, like picnic. And you still remember c k and k.

example.say: Look at make. The one letter before the k sound is a. It is a long vowel, with a sneaky e. So we spell it k e.
